articles.text: At the golf course, Molina and White meet Colonel Harris. Harris greets them warmly and says he didn’t know Molina played golf. Molina admits he doesn’t play but White has promised to teach him. Harris calls White a fine player. They chat about whether Molina has seen the course and admire its beauty and the well cared‑for grass. Harris plays only nine holes and leaves early, asking White to remind his wife about a tennis date with Carmen. Later, three friends (Jaime, Víctor and Pedro) talk about how golf is a popular sport for businessmen: it’s often an excuse to get together, and sometimes business is just an excuse to play golf【265660559376534†L2470-L2562】.
